_sources.mu: median deseasonalized log-growth of last 12 quarters, shrunk 50% toward 1.2%/q
_sources.sigma_g: robust (MAD) AR(1) residual s.d. over 32 quarters
_sources.t_df: MLE Student-t fit on standardized growth residuals
_sources.beta_gdp: revenue sensitivity to nominal GDP (40 quarters), shrunk 50% toward 1.5
_sources.recession: NBER recessions since 1947 (12): entry 4.5%/q, mean length 4.2q
_sources.F,v: constrained regression of cash operating costs on revenue, 16 quarters
_sources.ddays: customer deposits / deferred revenue in days of revenue (cash collected in advance)
_sources.ocf_ratio: median unexplained operating cash flow / revenue (e.g. content spend, deferred revenue)
_sources.coupon: interest expense / debt, last 4 reported quarters (to 2026-06-30)
_sources.refi_ratio: share of maturities refinanced, inferred from the last 8 quarters' debt trend
_sources.sigma_fin: robust s.d. of quarterly % debt changes (discretionary financing), last 20 quarters
_sources.revolver_cap: assumption: committed facility = 8% of TTM revenue
_sources.cash_floor: half the company's 10th-percentile cash balance over 12 quarters (revealed minimum)
_sources.cash_cap: assumption: cash above 150% of today's level is swept into debt paydown
_sources.cash_target: assumption: treasury raises new debt when cash falls below 60% of today's level
